culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total | March 31, 2026 Number of Investments 278 | December 31, 2025 Number of Investments 257

rationale: The E07 source count of 535 is not a single-period anchor: it is exactly 278 current-period investments plus 257 comparative-period investments. Table 123 identifies those columns as March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. The output count of 283 is only five above the filing's current-period schedule total of 278, so the 47.1% flag is caused by summing comparative periods in the check rather than a demonstrated output data error.
